title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy’s Wimbledon Jacket
items.text: Rory McIlroy wore his Masters green jacket while watching Wimbledon, sparking debate and fan backlash over his limited nine-event PGA Tour schedule and exemption from the 15-event minimum.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau’s Tour Challenge
items.text: With the PGA Tour's 2028 promotion-relegation system, Bryson DeChambeau faces a one-year ban on return and might have to play in the lower-tier Challenger Series to regain PGA Tour status.
